כּוֹתֶל - כ"ו ת"ל. [ליקו"מ כ"ה]
כִּי בִי גִּימַטְרִיָּא מ"ב כְּמִנְיַן שְׁלֹשָׁה פְעָמִים י"ד. [ליקו"מ מ"ו]
כַּלֹּת רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת כַּפָּרָה לְכָל תּוֹלְדוֹתָם. [ליקו"מ קנ"א]
כּוֹסִי רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר יְיָ סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶךָ. [ליקו"מ קע"ז]
כִּסְלֵיו רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וַיַּרְא יְיָ כִּי סָר לִרְאוֹת. [ליקו"מ ח"ב ז']
כַּשֹּׁפָר רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת כָּפוּל שָׁלוּשׁ פָּשׁוּט רָבוּעַ. [ליקו"מ ח"ב ח']
כִּי אֲנִי יְיָ רֹפְאֶךָ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אָמֵן כֵּן יְהִי רָצוֹן. [ליקו"מ ח"ב מ"ב]
כָּרְסֵיהּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יוֹם כִּפּוּר סֻכּוֹת. [חיי"מ פ"ד]
כַּף קֶלַע בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא שִׁי"ן שָׁנָה. [חיי"מ תפ"ח]
כֶּסֶף בְּמִילוּאוֹ (כ"ף סמ"ך פ"א) בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא אֵשׁ. [חיי"מ ת"ר]

tay Mooharan 41

 ב׳שם י׳י א׳לקינו נ׳זכיר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "In the Name of Hashem our G-d we will call out" (ב׳שם י׳י א׳לקינו נ׳זכיר) [Psalms 20:8] spell נביא (navi, "prophet"). Calling out in G-d's Name is the act of prophecy.
 
 
 Sefer HaMidos, "Prayer" 2:14

 ב׳שמך י׳גילון כ׳ל ה׳יום
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "In Your Name they rejoice all the day" [Psalms 89:17] spell בכיה (bechiyah, "weeping"). [Cross-reference from Bechiyah above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 175; Chayay Mooharan §§13, 96

 ב׳שמן ק׳דשי מ׳שחתיו
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "with My holy oil have I anointed him" [Psalms 89:21] spell בקם (bekom). [Cross-reference from Bekom above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 57:3

 ב׳שמעו א׳ת ר׳נתם
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "when they heard their joyful song" [Numbers 21:17] spell באר (be'er, "a well"). [Cross-reference from Be'er above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 27:5

 בשר לב — ברסלב
 
 Tziroof

 Basar Lev (בשר לב, "heart of flesh") — its letters spell Breslov (ברסלב). [Cross-reference from Breslov above.]
 
 Chayay Mooharan §339

 בשרא
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Bisra (בשרא, Aramaic: "flesh") — first letters of ש׳שים ר׳בוא ב׳כרס א׳חד: "sixty myriads [of souls] in one belly." Every individual human being contains within them the entirety of the Jewish people — sixty myriads of souls in one body of flesh.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 2

 ב׳ת ע׳ין ש׳ין
 
 Tziroof

 The letters ב, ע, ש — Bais, Ayin, Shin — are the letters of עשב (eisev, "grass / herb"). [A permutation connecting three letters to the natural world — the source in Chayay Mooharan develops the significance of this connection.]
 
 Chayay Mooharan §92

 ב׳תולה נ׳שאת ל׳יום ה׳רביעי
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "a virgin is married on the fourth day [Wednesday]" (ב׳תולה נ׳שאת ל׳יום ה׳רביעי) [Mishnah, Kesuvos 1:1] spell לבנה (levanah, "the moon"). The marriage of a virgin on Wednesday — the day the moon was created — reveals the lunar connection embedded in the laws of marriage.
 
 
 Sefer HaMidos, "Marriage" 2

 ג׳אלת ש׳בט נ׳חלתך ה׳ר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "You redeemed the tribe of Your inheritance, [Mount Sinai]" (ג׳אלת ש׳בט נ׳חלתך ה׳ר) [Psalms 74:2] spell ה׳נ׳ג׳ש׳ — the four letters engraved on the dreidel (spinning top used on Chanukah). These four letters stand for Nes Gadol Hayah Sham — "A great miracle happened there."
 
 
 Sichos HaRan 40

 גבורה
 
 Gematria

 Gevurah (גבורה, "Strength / the sefirah of Might" = 216) equals the gematria of יָרָה (yarah, "he shot [an arrow] / he taught") together with the kollel [one additional unit for the word itself].
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 38:7

 גולָה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Golah (גולה, "exile") — its letters are the first letters of ו׳נשאר ג׳ם ה׳וא ל׳אלקינו: "and the remnant, even He, belongs to our G-d" [Obadiah 1:17]. Even within exile, G-d remains.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:76

 גילדנא
 
 Tziroof

 Gildena (גילדנא, Yiddish/Aramaic: "golden") — its letters contain both the Divine Name אג"ל (Agla — acronym of א׳תה ג׳בור ל׳עולם א׳דני, "You are mighty forever, my L-rd") and the Name אדני (Adonai) in their complete forms.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 5:5

 גלמי
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Golmi (גלמי, "my unformed substance / embryo" [Psalms 139:16]) — its letters are the first letters of י׳י מ׳לך ג׳אות ל׳בש: "Hashem reigns, He is clothed in majesty" [Psalms 93:1]. The unformed embryo already carries within it the King clothed in majesty.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5; 15

 גם
 
 Gematria

 Gam (גם, "also / even") embodies the aspect of challah — for challah is the measure of 43 eggs (מ"ג ביצים), and Gimel-Mem = 3+40 = 43. The word "also" encodes the measure of the sacred dough-offering.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 55:8

 גס רוח
 
 Notarikon

 Gas Ruach (גס רוח, "arrogance / coarseness of spirit") is the direct opposite of the Divine Name ס"ג [63 — the Name יוד הי ואו הי]. Arrogance is the inversion of the Name of Binah — Understanding and humility.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 135

 גרון
 
 Gematria

 Gayrohn (גרון, "throat" = 259) equals the gematria of Elokim three times (86 × 3 = 258, + 1 kollel = 259). The throat — vessel of all speech and song — corresponds to the threefold Name of judgment.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 46

 גרים
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Gairim (גרים, "converts / strangers") — its letters are the first letters of ר׳עם ג׳בורותיו מ׳י י׳תבונן: "the thunder of His mighty deeds — who can understand?" [Job 26:14]. The mystery of converts is as awesome and unfathomable as the thunder of G-d's power.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:8; 4

 ד׳אגה ב׳לב א׳יש י׳שחנה
 
 Roshay Saveivos (double)

 The first letters of "anxiety in a man's heart weighs it down" (ד׳אגה ב׳לב א׳יש י׳שחנה) [Proverbs 12:25] are identical to the first letters of ב׳רצות י׳י ד׳רכי א׳יש — "when Hashem is pleased with a man's ways" [Proverbs 16:7]. The very same letters that spell worry spell Divine favor — one transforms into the other.
 
 
 Omitted passages of Chayay Mooharan

 דָבָר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Davar (דָבָר, "a word / a thing") — its letters are the first letters of ד׳שנת ב׳שמן ר׳אשי: "You have anointed my head with oil" [Psalms 23:5]. A holy word is an anointing of the head with oil. [Cross-reference: Dishanta Veshemen Roshi → Davar, listed below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 177

 ד׳ברי א׳לקים ח׳יים
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "the words of the Living G-d" (ד׳ברי א׳לקים ח׳יים) spell אחד (echad, "one").
